text: {"lessons":["Selling after sharp losses locked in substantial losses; I should avoid panic-selling and make decisions based on a considered plan.","Selling more of the same stocks as prices fell did not prevent further declines in my account, so I should reassess risk and diversification rather than react repeatedly to recent price moves.","As a retiree relying on these savings, I should favor a steady, cautious approach and avoid frequent trading without a clear reason."]}
